text: In 2017, a parent challenged Simone Elkeles's Perfect Chemistry at Academy School District 20's Challenger Middle School Library in Colorado, objecting to language, alcohol use, violence and sexual descriptions. After an appeal to the school board, the superintendent's office overturned its previous decision and pulled the book and the series. The school board then voted to ban Perfect Chemistry from the Challenger Middle School Library, upholding a ruling that it was not age-appropriate for a middle school audience because of descriptions of sexual encounters, drug and alcohol use, violence and profanity.
